spark_open.description: The creature is a single quadrupedal animal shown in right-facing profile against a plain light background. Its overall body shape, fur, head, limbs and tail are those of a brown bear, but its back and forehead bear large, glossy, dark brown insect-like structures. Dense shaggy brown fur covers the body, with lighter tan-cream fur on the muzzle, lower jaw, chest, belly and inner sides, and darker brown on the back, limbs and neck. A large, smooth, highly reflective hard shell covers the dorsal surface from the shoulders to the rump, and a single long, curved, glossy horn projects upward and backward from the center of the forehead. The animal stands with all four paws on the ground, its short tail visible at the rear, and a row of small oval openings is visible in the fur just below the edges of the shell.
